$comment: Advisories that must not fail CI, with the reason each is accepted.
Keep this list as short as possible and re-check it on every dependency bump —
an entry is a promise to remove it, not a permanent exemption.
Everything not listed here still fails the build at high severity.

allow.reason: Reached only through @prisma/dev, the Prisma CLI's local development server. Production runs `prisma migrate deploy` and never starts that server, so the HTTP/2 DoS is not reachable. The only published fix downgrades prisma to 7.8.0, a breaking change.
Same dependency path as above (@prisma/dev); not reachable from the server runtime.
Flagged transitively because of the two advisories above; the package itself is development-only tooling.
allow.review: Drop together with the entries above.

allow.reason: Flagged only as the parent of @prisma/dev. The Prisma CLI is a runtime dependency because the container entrypoint applies migrations on boot.
allow.review: Drop together with the entries above.
